newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Crean unit sells interest in Master Products.
newsitem.headline: Crean unit sells interest in Master Products.

text.p: Industrial holding group James Crean Plc said on Thursday that its subsidiary James Crean International had disposed of its interest in Master Products Manufacturing Company Inc for a gross consideration of $10.69 million or 7.1 million punts.
This nets down to $9.81 million or 6.5 million punts after the assumption by the purchaser, Martin Yale Industries Inc, of certain liabilities, Crean said in a statement.
The net consideration has been discharged in cash and the proceeds will be used for development in Crean's core businesses, the company said.
